name: knowledge-work-plugins
description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
one_liner: A set of ready-made 'job packs' that turn a general AI assistant into a specialist for a specific role, like sales, HR, or finance, already knowing that role's tools and workflows.
buyer: An operations manager at a small-to-mid-size company who wants non-technical staff to get real value from AI without custom-building prompts themselves.
business_use_cases: An HR consultancy customizes the HR-focused plugin with a client's own policies and templates, then sells it as a packaged 'AI HR assistant' rollout.
A boutique agency builds and sells a niche plugin (e.g. for property management or nonprofit grant-writing) not covered by the official 11.
A company customizes an existing plugin with its internal terminology and tools, then trains staff on it as part of an AI-adoption initiative.

money_ideas.idea: Sell custom plugin development and configuration for a company's specific role and tools
Build and sell a niche industry plugin not covered by the official marketplace

steal_this: This weekend, build one plugin for an underserved role (e.g. property manager or nonprofit fundraiser) and list it for sale to agencies serving that niche.
